title: Optimal Task Pair Assignment
statement:
Pair tasks so each worker gets two jobs and the slowest worker is as fast as possible.

Contract
- `durations` is non-null and has even length. Durations are non-negative integers.
- Return an array of pairs. Every input duration must appear in exactly one returned pair, including duplicates.
- Among all pairings, minimize the maximum pair sum. Return pairs in nondecreasing order of their first value, and put the smaller value first inside each pair.
- Do not mutate `durations`.

Examples
- `assignPairs(new int[]{5, 2, 1, 6, 4, 4})` returns `[[1, 6], [2, 5], [4, 4]]`.
- `assignPairs(new int[]{1, 8, 9, 2})` returns `[[1, 9], [2, 8]]`.
- `assignPairs(new int[]{3, 3})` returns `[[3, 3]]`.
hints: Pairing the shortest remaining task with the longest remaining task controls the worst load.
Walk inward from both ends of the sorted array. Intended complexity: O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
inputSyntax: Input: task durations array, for example: [5, 2, 1, 6, 4, 4]
